_comment: Machine-checked by tools/compliance_check.py. Fill from the client's regulator rules and brokerage policy. Claude's defaults are only a starting point: the client's compliance contact has the final say.
require_all_strings: exact text that MUST appear on screen in every reel (licence numbers, brokerage name)
require_disclaimer: exact disclaimer sentence(s) for the end card
numbers_policy: No rates, payments, savings or percentages on screen unless the client supplies the figure and its source and date. Charts and diagrams without client data must be labelled ILLUSTRATION.
claims_policy: Educational language only: 'may', 'depending on your situation', 'subject to approval'. No promises of approval, savings or outcomes.
